config_files.pyrefly.toml:
preset = "default"
project-includes = ["<ROOT>/project/src"]
search-path = ["<ROOT>/project/src"]
project-excludes = ["<ROOT>/project/src/**/tests/**", "<ROOT>/project/src/**/_vendor/**"]
python-version = "3.12"
python-platform = "linux"
check-unannotated-defs = true
infer-return-types = "checked"
python-interpreter-path = "<ROOT>/venv/bin/python"
